method.fresh: Compare the frozen routes on two matched VCTK prompts per reader, with four readers excluded from the existing ODSS, PhonemeDF, serving, matched-babble, and PACC source IDs. Render the complete native genuine and VITS utterance, matched at publisher ID and transcript, in the Aachen meeting room. Alternate lateral paths and reuse each exact competing-speech segment and gain across origins. Take the earliest four nonoverlapping eligible six-second clips per AMI session, with at least 3.9 seconds of annotated speech, 350 ms of simultaneous speech, and 300 ms of annotated speech in each background-reference flank. Assess 0 and -5 dB, room-only and masker-only controls.
method.point: Keep the existing mono/WPE/frontal operating points from the published ODSS development role. Fit the flank projection point as the maximum admitted flank score across genuine mixed speech and isolated competing-speech controls from that same development role. Leave all mono flags in place. Add a flag only when the previous selective cleanup rule would add one and the flank score exceeds its independently fitted point.
method.projection: Use the existing square-root Hann transform. Estimate each complex mid/side regression coefficient from frames wholly contained within 0–1 and 5–6 seconds. Use the same diagonal floor, cap, sub-150 Hz exclusion, subtraction amount and output-availability checks as the existing whole-mixture frontal view. Apply frozen coefficients to all frames and reconstruct at the original sample clock.
method.scope: The whole foreground utterance is centered within the known 1.5–4.5-second window of a six-second stereo recording. The two outer one-second flanks are expected to carry background only. This geometry is part of the test design. The proposed check is inapplicable when there are no usable background-reference flanks.
